name: RAW_ARTIFACT_RETRIEVAL
findings: 27 raw artefacts materialized for the corpus: 15 IPP_XBRL + 6 ESEF_COVER + 6 ESEF_PACKAGE_ZIP_XBRL.
REMEDIATED: the 6 ESEF artefacts from R7 (now reclassified ESEF_COVER) were the Portada; the real ESEF iXBRL and ZIP/Xbri package were added as separate components.
The 6 ESEF_PACKAGE_ZIP_XBRL packages are the self-contained ESEF raw (iXBRL report + issuer extension taxonomy schema/linkbases + META-INF), ~10-34MB each, preserved with SHA-256.
The 6 IXBRL_CONSOLIDATED (real inline-XBRL report) were byte-stable out-of-session (recorded in esef_components.json); raw preserved inside the ZIP packages.
Metadata recorded: role, family, source_registration_no, source_url, final_url, retrieved_at, http_status, media_type, byte_size, elapsed_ms, set_cookie, sha256.
No re-serialisation; bytes written as received.
Observed: IPP H2 artefacts are much smaller than H1 (same taxonomy, fewer facts).
Model: 21 filings != 21 artefacts; an ESEF filing = filing_version with multiple artefacts (COVER / IXBRL_CONSOLIDATED / IXBRL_INDIVIDUAL / ESEF_PACKAGE_ZIP_XBRL).

Post-remediation audit: esef_components.json registro corrected - the scraper had captured the AUDITA column (audit-report numbers); official registro verified per-row in preserved ListadoIFA evidence (SAN 20875/20509, BBVA 20854/20448, IBE 20934/20515). ESEF_COVER source_registration_no placeholders corrected to the official registro.

Model decision verified: the reports/*.xhtml member of each ESEF_PACKAGE_ZIP_XBRL is byte-identical to the standalone consolidated XHTML served by the direct ?e= link (ixbrl_member_equality.json, 6/6 byte_equal). IXBRL_CONSOLIDATED is modelled as package member + direct CNMV view; persisted inventory stays 27.
limitations: The IXBRL_CONSOLIDATED standalone XHTML (up to ~118MB) is not stored as a separate repo file (size); its raw is preserved within the ZIP package, and its SHA/schemaRef are recorded.
